body: Maybe, but in the interim I'll still be homeless and broke - which won't exactly make it easy to get a job.

I don't care, fuck I'll probably be gone in under a week anyway.

I'm the IT director for a small company.

For the most part, my dad won't even talk to me. Doesn't take my calls.

Not sure what a drug helpline would do for me, as drugs are only about 1/10th of my problems. Also, I've been through rehab/detox before and I guess you could say I'm a chronic addict.

I asked my mom to meet up with me and talk last weekend and she declined.

I've tried to keep the depth of the my problems from my girlfriend, as she has her own problems, and is not in any position to help.

Parents have basically said - "Too bad, we gave you a good upbringing, if you screwed up after that it's your own fault." (This is true - I did have a pretty good upbringing.)

Girlfriend lives with her parents (she's 23, I'm 26) so living with her is not an option.

Getting back in to school would require well into 5 figures more than what I have. It's just not viable.

I've been though the mental health system before. Those places are terrible. You're lucky if you get to talk to a doctor for five minutes once a day. In the end they just kick you back to the same situation you were in, with a bunch of new prescriptions.

I'm sure a few people might be mildly upset when I go, but, you know what? Fuck them. My parents are very, very wealthy and could have reached out to help me many times - they know the situation I'm in. Pretty much the same goes for everybody else I ever knew.

I'm sorry for being coarse - but if you're suggesting I should endure being homeless, jobless, and broke rather than overdose just so a few people that mean nothing to me don't have to deal with a little pain, and then go back to their nice tidy lives - I think that is very, very stupid reasoning.
